retrievalProfile.description: A tactile assemblage portrait constructed from shattered ceramic plates and heavy impasto, framed by clean white borders and bold, high-contrast sans-serif typography.
triggerTerms: bold purple sans-serif on white border
excludeWhen: traditional oil painting without texture is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A central portrait rendered through the physical medium of broken ceramic shards and thick paint, set against a vibrant green background of circular plate fragments. The image is vertically sandwiched between two thick white horizontal bands containing large-scale, deep purple sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Textural chaos of the mosaic versus the clean geometric stability of the white borders
Complementary relationship between the lime green background and the deep purple typography
Circular motifs of the plates echoing the organic curves of the facial features
High-contrast value shifts between the white ceramic highlights and dark painted shadows
coreInvariants: White horizontal header and footer bands
Shattered ceramic texture throughout the subject and background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The portrait is centrally located, filling approximately 70% of the vertical space between the white bands.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes of the portrait, though fragmented, serve as the primary focal point within the textural field.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top bold text, moves down through the textured face, and rests on the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The white horizontal bands provide essential 'breathing room' and structural contrast to the dense, busy mosaic.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crimson red and ochre (clothing and skin tones within the mosaic)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the greens and purples; high value contrast between the white borders and the dark text.
paletteRestrictions: Vibrant green base for the central image

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' has a straight diagonal leg
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family usage for maximum impact and clarity.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, classic grotesque feel and weight.
Provides the necessary clean, neutral structure.
If a more condensed and aggressive look is desired.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with glasses constructed entirely from shattered green, white, and red ceramic plates and thick impasto paint. Place this image between two solid white horizontal bars at the top and bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a bold sans-serif font like Franklin Gothic Heavy, typeset the primary text in all-caps, centered within the top and bottom white bars using a deep purple color.

verificationChecks: Text is centered in white bands
Mosaic texture is visible on the face
No text overlaps the artwork area

adjustableVariables: Specific hue of the purple text
mustRedesign: The specific facial likeness must be generalized to a generic male portrait
Any specific brand logos on the ceramic shards must be removed
The specific wording of the text must be replaced with user-defined content

mustAchieve: Clear distinction between the textured art and the clean typography
avoid: Overlapping the text onto the mosaic

postGenerationChecks: Is the mosaic texture convincing as physical ceramic?
Are the white bands perfectly horizontal and solid?
Is the text color a consistent deep purple?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject] in [Ceramic Mosaic Style] with [Color] background, framed by [White Bands] containing [Bold Sans-Serif Text] in [Contrast Color].
